resolved_finding.issue: Acquisition status/phase and completed metadata collection identity were initially not required; the authored fixture itself omitted status/phase.
resolved_finding.fix: Requires sealed metadata_only acquisition and exact acquisition-seal protocol/input hashes inside parent seal. Requires completed collection manifest, exact embedded acquisition seal/protocol, topology artifact hashes, frame length and parent positions. Eight authored denial subcases cover missing/draft phase/status and failed/missing/changed collection bindings before parent enumeration.

reviewed_boundaries.metadata_before_bytes: All three exact parent IDs selected from the bound72-position frame; amendedh23 windows, full ordered parents/timestamps and first-parent continuity are checked globally using metadata only. Only then enumerate_parent may issue a tree read for one of the three authorized parents.
reviewed_boundaries.tree_and_size_scope: ls-tree -rz omits size expansion. Outside-package/excluded-component/non-Python/nonregular entries receive inventory reasons without cat-file size/body reads. Only eligible regular package .py blobs are sized; bodies larger than2MiB are not read. Raw retained bytes, full tree metadata and exclusion inventories remain available on failure.
reviewed_boundaries.ranking: Complete readable parent package inventory and AST/production-definition eligibility precede ranking. Rank is the frozen SHA seed+parent/path/qualname, full digest ascending then path/qualname. Direct unique functions only; conditional/nested/method/duplicate/type-param/production-ambiguous subjects excluded. Fewerfour or later packet-size failure stops, never substitutes.
reviewed_boundaries.expected_vs_truth: Expected normalized signatures/AST hashes deliberately come from shared production syntax. This is generation, not independent truth. Collector never imports/calls reference checker or AI; manifest remains prepared_awaiting_packet_seal_and_independent_review with zero reference/AI calls.
reviewed_boundaries.claims_provenance: New-derived IDs and original_candidate_id=null; paired exists/signature claims preserve complete canonical claim hashes, parent fullsource SHA/GitOID, symbol AST SHA/range, ranks and research provenance. File scope uses complete module hash/range; symbol scope uses definition hash/range. Known-incomplete input remains explicit; no original630 remark/admission is modified.
reviewed_boundaries.controls: Each packet contains eight realcases plus two signature mismatches, one nonexistent name and one appended-duplicate uncertainty control. Fresh names collision-check original bytes; mismatch handles empty signatures; duplicates appended at module indentation. Public sources are complete.raw bytes, not snippets. Private maps and answer keys stay outside public packet; deterministic opaque IDs/order hide control labels, not project/source identity.
reviewed_boundaries.prompts_and_tokens: Envelope includes every public case/source file, rubric, review schema and all copied sealed prompt files. Local pinned tiktoken0.12.0/o200k_base helper computes a named estimate offline. Complete envelope and digest retained; >64k stops without truncation/substitution. Native model context, harness overhead and billing are explicitly outside estimate claim; final response8k acceptance remains a later bound artifact.
reviewed_boundaries.method: Study-plan/amendment identity, prior v1 failure hashes, unchanged frame binding, zero pre-amendment source/AI/reference counters, actual72frame andh23 disjoint parent windows are enforced. Original v1 failure is preserved.
reviewed_boundaries.resources: Observed output-storage/self+completed-childCPU/wall checks are charged from collection entry and preserve failed outputs; a single operation may overshoot before next guard. No real collection or benchmark was performed by reviewer.

bounded_limits: Eligibility is deliberately production/AST generation scope; later independent reference/AI may exclude selected candidates, with no replacement.
Hashes/declared invocation identities are integrity bindings, not signatures or proof of model/training independence.
Sealed analysis/tokenizer code and ordinary local Git/object environment are trusted; project source is never executed.
